title: Infinite Method Object
description:
Write a function that returns an **infinite-method**** object**.

An **infinite-method**** object** is defined as an object that allows you to call any method and it will always return the name of the method.

For example, if you execute `obj.abc123()`, it will return `"abc123"`.

examples.explanation: The returned string should always match the method name.

hints: Analyze the constraints and data structures appropriate for Infinite Method Object.
Formulate an optimal state transition or traversal invariant.
Consider corner testcases and boundary limits.
